questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded in half from bottom to top. Two holes are punched: one directly on the folded horizontal edge near the left side and one away from that edge near the right side. When the sheet is completely unfolded, what appears?

choices.A: Two holes, both on the horizontal centerline
choices.C: Three holes: one on the horizontal centerline at left and a vertical mirrored pair at right
choices.D: Three holes in one horizontal row

questions.correctAnswer: Three holes: one on the horizontal centerline at left and a vertical mirrored pair at right
questions.explanation: The punch on the fold remains single, while the off-fold punch reflects across the horizontal centerline.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from the upper-left corner to the lower-right corner. The resulting triangle is then folded so the upper-right corner meets the lower-left corner. One hole is punched away from all folded edges. When the sheet is completely unfolded, what appears?

choices.A: Two holes mirrored across one diagonal only
choices.C: Four holes related by reflections across both diagonals
choices.D: Eight holes arranged around the center

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes related by reflections across both diagonals
questions.explanation: Two diagonal folds create four layers, so reversing both folds reflects the punch across each diagonal.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded in half from right to left. A small V-shaped cut is made on the bottom edge of the folded sheet, away from the vertical fold. When the sheet is unfolded, what appears?

choices.B: Two matching V-shaped notches on the bottom edge, mirrored left and right
choices.C: Two matching V-shaped notches on the left and right edges
choices.D: Four V-shaped notches along the bottom edge

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching V-shaped notches on the bottom edge, mirrored left and right
questions.explanation: The vertical half-fold reflects the bottom-edge cut to the corresponding position on the other half.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from left to right and then from top to bottom. One hole is punched directly on the folded vertical edge but away from the folded horizontal edge. When the sheet is completely unfolded, what appears?

choices.D: Two holes on the vertical centerline, reflected across the horizontal centerline
